answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, expired if not renewed by fresh work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the lotus of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. The beacon lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the sable is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short.
